biological.citation: SOX11 regulates SWI/SNF complex components as member of the adrenergic neuroblastoma core regulatory circuitry. (PMID: 36882421)
biological.summary: SOX11 is identified as a dependency transcription factor in adrenergic neuroblastoma, regulated by adrenergic-specific super-enhancers and part of the core regulatory circuitry (CRC). SOX11 directly regulates 10 SWI/SNF core components including SMARCC1, SMARCA4/BRG1, and ARID1A, as well as HDAC2, CBX2, KDM1A/LSD1, and c-MYB, positioning it as an epigenetic master regulator. SOX11 expression is driven by recurrent chromosome 2p focal gains and amplifications in high-risk neuroblastoma.

biological.citation: Lineage specific transcription factor waves reprogram neuroblastoma from self-renewal to differentiation. (PMID: 38653778)
biological.summary: SOX11 is associated with a super-enhancer linked to stem cell self-renewal in neuroblastoma, and its expression decreases upon ATRA-induced differentiation. CRISPR-Cas9 and siRNA knockdown verified SOX11 dependency both in vitro and in vivo. Silencing the SOX11 super-enhancer using dCAS9-KRAB decreased SOX11 mRNA and inhibited neuroblastoma cell growth.

biological.citation: The SOX11:SMARCA4 complex is a driver of oncogenic transcriptional programs in mantle cell lymphoma. (PMID: 40739087)
biological.summary: SOX11 physically interacts with SMARCA4, the catalytic subunit of the SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complex, as validated by co-immunoprecipitation and proteomic strategies. SOX11 and SMARCA4 share binding sites at open chromatin and active promoters, co-regulating key oncogenic pathways including BCR, NIK, and BCL2 signaling in MCL. SMARCA4 expression is directly regulated by SOX11, and PROTAC-mediated SMARCA4 degradation reduced SOX11 binding and induced apoptosis in SOX11-positive MCL cells.

biological.citation: SOX11 is a novel binding partner and endogenous inhibitor of SAMHD1 ara-CTPase activity in mantle cell lymphoma. (PMID: 38237141)
biological.summary: SOX11 was identified as a novel direct binding partner of SAMHD1 via co-immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometry in MCL cell lines, validated by proximity ligation assay. In vitro, SAMHD1 bound to the HMG box of SOX11 with low-micromolar affinity, and SOX11-SAMHD1 binding reduced SAMHD1 tetramerization. Functionally, SOX11 expression inhibited SAMHD1 ara-CTPase activity in a dose-dependent manner, resulting in cytarabine sensitization in cell lines and a SOX11-inducible mouse model of MCL.

biological.citation: SOX11, CD70, and Treg cells configure the tumor-immune microenvironment of aggressive mantle cell lymphoma. (PMID: 34189576)
biological.summary: SOX11 directly targets CD70, whose overexpression is induced in SOX11+ MCL tumor cells by CD40L stimulation in vitro. SOX11+ MCL showed significantly lower T-cell intratumoral infiltration and reduced MHCI/II-like and T-cell costimulation transcripts compared to SOX11- cases. CD70 overexpression driven by SOX11 was associated with increased Treg cell infiltration and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment promoting MCL progression.
biological.sample_size: 730 immune-related genes analyzed; primary nodal MCL cases

biological.citation: Human fetal cerebellar cell atlas informs medulloblastoma origin and oncogenesis. (PMID: 36450980)
biological.summary: SOX11 was identified as a transcriptional determinant in transitional cerebellar progenitor populations connecting neural stem cells to neuronal lineages in developing fetal cerebella. SOX11 expression in these progenitors is correlated with clinical prognosis in group 3 medulloblastomas. Genomic and Hi-C profiling identified de novo long-range chromatin loops juxtaposing SOX11-targeted super-enhancers to cis-regulatory elements of MYC, and targeting SOX11 inhibited MYC expression and group 3 MB growth.

biological.citation: Transcriptional dynamics orchestrating the development and integration of neurons born in the adult hippocampus. (PMID: 39028813)
biological.summary: SOX11 (along with SOX4) is identified as a SoxC transcription factor whose activity is shut down during the transition from immature to mature adult-born granule cells in the hippocampus. Overexpression of SOX11 in adult-born granule cells caused them to remain immature, demonstrating that downregulation of SOX11 is required for proper neuronal maturation. This was shown using single-nuclei RNA sequencing combined with functional overexpression experiments.

biological.citation: SOX11 as a potential prognostic biomarker in hepatocellular carcinoma linked to immune infiltration and ferroptosis. (PMID: 39246708)
biological.summary: SOX11 is significantly elevated in HCC tumors compared to normal liver tissue, and its levels correlate with HCC stage, histologic grade, and tumor status. Knockdown of SOX11 in HepG2 and HuH7 HCC cell lines resulted in reduced proliferation and migration. SOX11 expression showed significant associations with immune infiltration, ferroptosis-associated genes, and immune checkpoint genes in HCC tissue.
biological.sample_size: TCGA-LIHC dataset; HepG2 and HuH7 cell lines

biological.citation: Temporal controls over inter-areal cortical projection neuron fate diversity. (PMID: 34754107)
biological.summary: SOX11 is identified as a temporally differentially expressed transcription factor in motor cortex-projecting versus secondary somatosensory cortex-projecting inter-areal cortical projection neurons (ICPN) in the mouse neocortex. Postnatal manipulation of SOX11 expression in primary somatosensory cortex impaired sensorimotor connectivity and disrupted selective exploratory behaviours in mice. These findings reveal that dynamic differences in SOX11 expression levels contribute to intra-type diversity in cortical neuron circuit connectivity.

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - SOX11 is necessary for development of the bony labyrinth. (E.D. Sperry et al.)
biological.summary: Loss of Sox11 in mice results in lateral and posterior semicircular canal dysplasia, with failure of lateral semicircular canal fusion plate formation observed in Sox11-/- embryos at E11.5 and E12.5. Sox11+/- mice exhibited mild high-frequency hearing loss and significant reduction in vestibular sensory evoked potential P1 latencies. SOX11 expression is regulated by CHD7 (the chromatin remodeler altered in CHARGE syndrome), and Sox11 mediates spatiotemporal regulation of Bmp4, Otx1, and Shh during inner ear morphogenesis.
